samples.title: Midpoint chain: Proof strip
samples.statement:
A two-speed inspection wheel locates the second middle label of an even-length chain. Pia rolls a fresh proof strip into the office typewriter. The supervisor wants the readings in their precise working order before signing the file.

Find the middle node using fast and slow pointers, choosing the second middle for even-length lists. Produce values from that node to the tail; an empty head produces no values.

Return the entire derived sequence, preserving its order.

Implement midpointChainProofStrip(head, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.

samples.title: Midpoint chain: Peak ticket
samples.statement:
A two-speed inspection wheel locates the second middle label of an even-length chain. Mina is setting the upper stop on an old office gauge. The largest derived reading goes on its label, even if the whole tray is below zero.

Find the middle node using fast and slow pointers, choosing the second middle for even-length lists. Produce values from that node to the tail; an empty head produces no values.

Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative.

Implement midpointChainPeakTicket(head, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.

samples.title: Midpoint chain: Boss receipt
samples.statement:
A two-speed inspection wheel locates the second middle label of an even-length chain. Alma adds numbered weights to the final receipt at the unit's inspection desk. The first derived reading has weight one, so its position matters as much as its value.

Find the middle node using fast and slow pointers, choosing the second middle for even-length lists. Produce values from that node to the tail; an empty head produces no values.

Return the weighted sum of the derived sequence: multiply its first value by 1, its second by 2, and so on, then add the products. Return 0 for an empty sequence.

Implement midpointChainBossReceipt(head, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.
